name: Roughly Enough Items (REI)
summary: Item and recipe browser shown beside the inventory. Look up recipes and uses, search items, favourite them and fill crafting grids. A server component lets REI receive recipe data.

mechanics.title: Advanced search
mechanics.description: @modname searches by mod, #text searches tooltips, $tag searches tags, r/regex/ uses regular expressions, quotes allow spaces, | means OR.

mechanics.title: Incomplete recipe data
mechanics.description: On servers REI may lack recipe data; an operator can run /recipe give @p * to unlock them.

qol: Favourites by pressing A while hovering
Craftable filter, dark theme, reduced motion options
commands_and_keybinds: /recipe give @p * - vanilla command to reveal all recipes if data is missing
getting_started: Open your inventory; the item list appears on the right. Click an item for its recipe.
editor_notes: Recipe/usage keys (standard REI R and U) not in facts. Requires Architectury.
